scope: Linux local stdlib finite environment construction and validation; no engines
mapping: one identically named direct child directory per key under caller-created fresh owned absolute root
prepare: copy base environment, preflight all reserved paths absent, mkdir each exist_ok=False, override five keys; never log complete base environment
validate: all five values exactly match mapping; existing real directories; reject symlink root components and child paths
tests: hostile inherited five values replaced without input mutation
child symlink rejects without touching outside sentinel
one synthetic Python child reports five keys and writes five sentinel files
execution: normal and -O suites, exactly one synthetic child per suite, no subprocesses in rejection cases
limits: caller owns cleanup including partial creation failure; no TOCTOU defense, sandbox, complete environment isolation, automatic adoption or historical migration
